column1: # 上游新加的标记先在这里归类，再决定 player_guard.h 要不要改。格式：名字<TAB>allow|deny
# Classification of the engine's marker files for the player variant: every gfx-* name that appears in libdm.so must be listed here (shell_apk.sh
# checks it when building player and stops when one is missing). allow = read and written as usual in player (the pipeline crash guard's own state
# files, exactly the ones player_guard.h lets through); deny = behaves as missing in player (diagnostic, A/B and performance switches; the App's defaults
# decide). A marker newly added upstream is classified here first, then decide whether player_guard.h has to change. Format: name<TAB>allow|deny
